scope: Actual command model geometry, retained source identity, and successful Undo/Redo. Native helper selection, UI picking, attributes, continuous surface distance and performance parity are not qualified.
failure_policy: Viboceros rolls back all source edits on failure; Rhino deleted the profile in four captured failures.

python_api.timing_note: Timings are harness measurements, not kernel speedups. Timed work may differ between engines (including geometry extraction and cleanup); Rhino includes the Python/RhinoCommon bridge and any host emulation overhead. See docs/oracle.md#timing-interpretation.
